text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, while I'm on my way to the
library to
look for some useful books...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I've been searching for a few books to
help me
prepare for my races, you see.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
However, I've only been able to locate
one of
them, so I was mulling over what
to do.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Let's see... The Secrets to Running, The Essence of Speed, Running Stride: A Racing Memoir, as well as...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Grass Wonder continues to rattle off a
long list of
other books she's after. It'll
be a tough task trying
to find all of
them.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
That's a good point. I'll start reading it
now.
Wasting my limited time
overthinking this won't
do me any good
anyway.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Hmm, I see. Yes, this is quite useful! ♪

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
You'd be willing to help? Then I will
happily take
you up on that offer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It takes a whole lot of time, but we
manage to
find all the books Grass
Wonder is looking for.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much. You were most
helpful!
Now I believe my studies will
progress
swimmingly! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Helping Grass Wonder on her quest for

knowledge has made me a little more
familiar
with the library's collection.
